text: How many Mach-Zehnder interferometers are required for a mesh that can implement an arbitrary N x N unitary matrix?
explanation: A universal N x N unitary mesh uses N(N-1)/2 MZIs, matching the parameter dimension of the group U(N) exactly. N^2 overcounts (that is the number of real matrix entries), 2N-3 is the depth of the Reck triangular mesh (not the device count), and N*log2(N) is an FFT-style scaling that does not apply.
